newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock says NatWest to pull out of fund manager.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock says NatWest to pull out of fund manager.

text.p: Hong Kong conglomerate Wheelock & Company Ltd said on Friday it was disappointed by National Westminster Bank Plc's decision to pull out the fund management arm of their joint venture Wheelock NatWest.
"Yes, obviously we're disappointed," said Nicholas Sibley, who is deputy chairman of Wheelock NatWest.
Wheelock and National Westminster created the joint venture, Wheelock Natwest, in 1994 to offer investment management, corporate finance and equity stockbroking in Hong Kong.

Sibley denied National Westminster's decision to pull out of the investment management division, Wheelock NatWest Investment Management, signalled its imminent departure from the entire joint venture, which became fully operational only one year ago.
"There's no question of the equity and corporate finance business breaking up or anything like that. That is running perfectly satisfactorily," he said.
Wheelock is seeking alternative partners for National Westminster's 50-percent stake in the fund management company, he said.
